steps.title: Front stub and journal
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as crankshaft_4.ipt.
Sketch on the XY Plane the half section: 32 diameter for 110, then 64 diameter for 38. Revolve about the axis.

steps.title: Throw 1: front web
actions: Sketch a web on the end face of the front journal: a circle R70 on the main axis, a circle R36 on the pin centre 44 below the axis, and two lines Tangent to the R36 circle at 33 degrees to each other, closed by an arc R80 on the main axis (the counterweight, opposite the pin). Trim. Extrude 15.5 mm.
steps.note: Section A-A on the sheet shows the web: the R80 counterweight, the 33 degree sides and the R36 (72 diameter) pin end.

steps.title: Throw 1: crank pin
actions: Sketch a 64 circle on the web face on the R36 centre, 44 below the axis. Extrude 45 mm.

steps.title: Throw 1: rear web
actions: Work Plane through the middle of the crank pin (Offset 22.5 from the web face). Mirror the front web about it.

steps.title: Main journal 2
actions: Sketch a 64 circle on the main axis on the rear web. Extrude 38 mm.

steps.title: Throw 2: front web
actions: Sketch the same web on the end of journal 2, but with the pin centre 44 above the axis (throw 2 is turned 180 degrees from throw 1). Extrude 15.5 mm.

steps.title: Throw 2: crank pin
actions: Sketch a 64 circle on the R36 centre, 44 above the axis. Extrude 45 mm.

steps.title: Throw 2: rear web
actions: Work Plane through the middle of the pin. Mirror the front web about it.

steps.title: Main journal 3
actions: Sketch a 64 circle on the main axis on the rear web. Extrude 38 mm.

steps.title: Throw 3 and journal 4
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Rectangular Pattern
actions: Rectangular Pattern: the two throw 2 webs, its pin and journal 3. Direction along the shaft axis, 2 occurrences, 114 apart.
steps.note: Throws 2 and 3 point the same way, so a pattern copies throw 2.

steps.title: Throw 4 and the rear journal
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Rectangular Pattern
actions: Rectangular Pattern: the two throw 1 webs, its pin and journal 2. 2 occurrences, 342 apart (3 x 114). The copied journal ends at 604, where the flange starts.
steps.note: Pins 1 and 4 point down and pins 2 and 3 point up, so the shaft balances end to end.

steps.title: Flange
actions: Sketch a 144 circle on the end of the rear journal. Extrude 15 mm (619 overall).

steps.title: Flange holes
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Circular Pattern
actions: Hole 10 diameter on the 109 pitch circle, Through. Circular Pattern: 6.
steps.note: The flywheel bolts to these holes.

steps.title: Flange chamfer
actions: Chamfer 2 mm on the outside edge of the flange.

steps.title: Front end chamfer
actions: Chamfer 1 mm on the front end of the stub.
